The Role:  Riggy acts as a model and actor who stars alongside Danno in educational, fast-fact YouTube Shorts. He also runs his own Riggy The Rabbit Monkey YouTube Channel. Personality:  He is an anarchic, chaotic anti-hero. While usually friendly, he possesses a massive, comedic criminal record featuring arson, tax fraud, and property damage.
